Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.physics

Class PhysicsPlane

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.physics.PhysicsObject
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.physics.PhysicsBody
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.physics.PhysicsPlane
All Implemented Interfaces:
Collideable
public class PhysicsPlane extends PhysicsBody implements Collideable
An unbounded plane in the physics simulation, defined by a point and a normal.

    • PhysicsPlane

      public PhysicsPlane(org.jogamp.vecmath.Vector3f normal, org.jogamp.vecmath.Vector3f point, float restitution, float friction)
      Creates a new static plane with the given normal, position and constants.
      Parameters:
      normal - the planes normal pointing outwards from the plane.
      point - any point in the plane.
      restitution - the plane's restitution constant.
      friction - the plane's friction constant.
